Character Creation · Step 3 of 11

Career

Your career sets 8 career skills. They are the only skills you can take free ranks in at creation, and they cost 5 less XP per rank than non-career skills for the rest of your character’s life. A career is a permanent discount on this set.

Edge of the Empire p.54 p.102

What you may choose from is set by the books you have enabled, not by your game line. Three cores on means all three lines’ careers; the line you picked at step 1 decides your mechanic, not your catalogue. Each row names its book.

Hired Gun

Edge of the Empire

Hired Guns are professional combatants who sell their martial skills to the highest bidder. They work as bodyguards, mercenaries, enforcers, and soldiers of fortune across the Outer Rim. Some are former military; others learned to fight in gladiatorial pits, street gangs, or planetary militias. What they share is an aptitude for violence and a practical understanding of its application.
